# AI Agent Summit 2027

> A one-day showcase on Friday 16 April 2027 at World Trade Center Mumbai (Cuffe Parade, Mumbai 400005, India). Companies that have built AI agents apply for a 10-minute innovation talk on the main stage (7 minutes of live demo, 3 minutes of questions) plus a showcase spot on the floor all day. Organised by Aegis Knowledge Trust, the team behind Bharat AI Innovation.

## Key facts
- Date: Friday 16 April 2027, doors 08:30 IST, stage 09:00 to 19:00, cocktail evening 19:30 to 21:00
- Venue: World Trade Center Mumbai, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai
- Format: 50 ten-minute stage slots, open to every kind of AI agent (44 for showcase companies, 6 for partner keynotes and talks); the running order is published once the companies are confirmed; showcase floor all day; audience-voted Best Agent of the Summit plus category awards, announced at the cocktail evening
- Contact: info@bharataiinnovation.com, +91 89765 80367

## More ways to take part
- AI Agent Challenge: free, online, teams of one to four that have not raised outside funding; register by 31 January 2027, submit by 28 February 2027, five finalists named by 15 March 2027 and shown free on the main stage on 16 April 2027
- Problem board: companies post tasks they want an AI agent for; showcase companies and challenge teams can pick one to demo
- Break the agent: an open booth where visitors try to make volunteer agents misbehave, with a leaderboard
- Scored by the room: after every slot, everyone with a vote scores the demo on their phone; the scores count towards Best Agent of the Summit
- Agents of India 2027: a report of totals from every application and challenge entry, launched on 16 April 2027

## Showcase packages (INR, excluding 18% GST; charged only after acceptance)
- Startup Showcase: 38,000; raised under 25 crore or bootstrapped; stage slot and 24 sq ft pod; 20 slots
- Growth Showcase: 1,49,000; raised 25 to 200 crore; stage slot and 43 sq ft booth; 14 slots
- Enterprise Showcase: 2,95,000; above 200 crore, listed companies, MNCs; stage slot and 65 sq ft booth; 10 slots
- Custom booth: 6,000 per sq ft, 200 sq ft minimum (from 12,00,000), with everything in Enterprise Showcase; book by 15 February 2027
- Team passes: Startup 2, Growth 4 (1 VIP), Enterprise and custom booth 6 (2 VIP); every team pass includes lunch and the cocktail evening

## Passes (INR, excluding GST)
- Visitor: free
- Student and Academic: 999
- Delegate: 3,999 (2,499 until 31 January 2027)
- VIP: 12,999
- Buyer and Investor: free, on approval
- Cocktail evening (19:30 to 21:00): VIP, Buyer and Investor passes, showcase team passes and partner passes

## Partner packages (INR, excluding GST)
- Presenting Partner 20,00,000 (one); Platinum 10,00,000 (two); Gold 5,00,000 (four); every partner pass includes lunch and the cocktail evening
- Add-ons from 1,50,000; cocktail evening partner 5,00,000
- Extra floor space: 6,000 per sq ft, 200 sq ft minimum, booked by 15 February 2027
